title: [H1] Monday-long / Thursday-short day-of-week effect
falsifiable_prediction:
Monday mean 1h return > 0 and Thursday < 0 for the
  11 long-history coins in the *next* 8+ weeks of data; basket test (equal-weight
  long Monday / short Thursday) positive net of fees.

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Observation (2026-08-06, n≈29 weeks, 1h bars):** mean 1h return on Mondays is positive across all four pairs (BTC +2.7, ETH +4.9, SOL +3.8, HYPE +6.2 bps/h); Thursdays negative for BTC/ETH/SOL (−4.0 to −6.5 bps/h), but NOT for HYPE (+2.3).

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Cross-validation (2026-08-06, 12-coin universe):** Monday positive in **11/12** coins (only LIT flat at −0.3); Thursday negative in **12/12** (mean −5.7 bps/h, range −2.0 to −10.0 excluding CASHCAT). Individual t-stats mostly marginal (ETH −2.59, XRP −2.28 significant; WLD Monday +2.12) but sign consistency across 12 coins is the evidence: P(12/12 negative | null) ≈ 0.02%. Effect is broad, not coin-specific.

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Session interaction (2026-08-07, deep-dive c):** Thursday negativity is NOT concentrated in US hours. Equal-weight across 11 coins: Asia 00–07 UTC −7.85 bps (t=−5.64), US 13–20 UTC −7.31 bps (t=−4.99), Europe 08–12 UTC −1.63 bps. 9/11 coins negative in US hours. Monday positivity IS session-dependent: Europe +11.03, US +7.56, Asia +1.07 bps. H1 is a 24-hour calendar effect, not an intraday-session artifact.

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Vol-regime conditioning (2026-08-08, deep-dive d):** H1 is AMPLIFIED in high-vol regimes. Equal-weight across 11 coins: Mon HIGH vol +6.21 bps (t=3.72) vs Mon LOW vol +2.78 bps (t=1.92); Thu HIGH vol −6.44 bps (t=−3.56) vs Thu LOW vol −4.07 bps (t=−2.95). Same sign in both regimes; high vol sharpens the effect.

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Persistence (2026-08-09):** 5 consecutive daily records show Monday 10/11 positive, Thursday 11/11 negative. Mean Thu bps stable (−5.48 → −5.49 → −5.42 → −5.42 → −5.42). Basket Sharpe stable (2.61 → 2.62 → 2.59 → 2.58 → 2.58). No decay detected.

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Timeframe robustness (2026-08-09, deep-dive b):** H1 raw effect is IDENTICAL at 4h and 1d resolutions: 10/11 coins positive Monday, 11/11 negative Thursday at 1h/4h/1d. 4h basket Sharpe **3.43** exceeds 1h (2.58), suggesting the effect is cleaner at coarser granularity. 1d backtest is negative (−6.2%) due to fee/execution erosion — raw effect exists but naive daily-close execution fails to capture it.

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **OOS basket (2026-08-09, Week 1):** frozen from discovery (2026-08-06 19:00 UTC): **−0.90% / 61h**, Sharpe −19.5 — flat/negative first week but <3 days elapsed; next meaningful reading after first full Mon→Thu cycle post-discovery (Aug 11–14).

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Basket backtest (2026-08-06, IN-SAMPLE — discovery window = test window):** equal-weight long-Monday / short-Thursday across 11 long-history coins, net of 4.5bps taker fee: **+54.7% over ~7 months, Sharpe 2.61, max DD −16.3%**, 30% exposure. Promising, but the pattern was *selected* on this same data — treat as hypothesis-confirmation, not evidence of forward edge. True test = metrics_history persistence + live forward performance.

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Cautions:** ~29 observations per weekday per coin; effect size small per-hour; in-sample backtest is NOT validation; needs out-of-sample persistence before `supported`.

evidence.author: archaeologist
evidence.note: Equities Lab #3 first hunt (D-0006) independently found Thursday-negative (-13.5 bps/day, 18/24 sign consistency) — strengthens H1's Thursday leg as a possible cross-asset effect rather than a crypto-only artifact.

title: [H2] Mid-cap 1h mean-reversion
falsifiable_prediction:
negative lag-1 autocorr in HYPE/LIT persists in new
  data, and a fade-the-last-hour rule beats random net of Hyperliquid fees/slippage.

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Observation (2026-08-06):** HYPE 1h return lag-1 autocorrelation −0.041 vs ≈0 for BTC/ETH. Suggests weak short-term reversion in the least-liquid asset.

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Cross-validation (2026-08-06, 12-coin universe):** 8/12 coins negative (mean −0.019), but significant only in HYPE (−0.041), LIT (−0.048) and CASHCAT (−0.133, short sample). **Exception: WLD is significantly POSITIVE (+0.044) — it trends at 1h, opposite direction.** Majors (BTC/ETH/XRP) ≈ 0. Refined: reversion is a *specific mid-caps* phenomenon, not universal; WLD excluded and tracked as its own micro-trend candidate.

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Timeframe decay (2026-08-09, deep-dive b):** the 1h mean-reversion in HYPE/LIT **disappears entirely at 4h**. HYPE ac1 at 4h is near-zero and not significant; mean ac1 across 11 coins flips to +0.020 (slight momentum). At 1d, only XRP and WLD are significant. The effect is purely intraday microstructure (likely bid-ask bounce / inventory management), not multi-hour mean-reversion.

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Cautions:** effect size tiny; perp fees + spread may erase it. Any position held longer than ~1h will not capture the effect. Revisit in **1 week**; if 4h remains null, downgrade toward `rejected` for tradeable purposes.

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Observation (2026-08-06):** realized 1h vol peaks 13–15 UTC (US session open) and troughs 04–09 UTC for BTC/ETH/SOL; HYPE vol ~1.4–2× SOL at all hours.

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Use:** any entry/exit timing and stoploss sizing should be hour-aware. Also: signals fired in low-vol hours deserve separate validation.

evidence.author: hl_monitor
evidence.note: - **Update (2026-08-08):** vol regime now shown to condition both H1 (stronger in high vol) and H4 (fade only in high vol). Vol is a context layer, not alpha alone, but essential for signal calibration.

title: [BF-C] fadebot stop placed inside pump continuation range
hypothesis: Stopped trades (n=20, 0 wins, -5.51 total) had stop distances of 0.25-0.50 price units against pump sizes of 0.65-1.8: the stop sits inside the pump's normal continuation range and converts correct directional reads into realised losses.
falsifiable_prediction: Over the next 4 weeks of fadebot trades, stopped-out trades with stop_distance < pump_size continue to realise ~100% losses, while trades that survive to window exit retain the 80% directional edge. Widening stops beyond 1.2x pump_size (or removing them with a size cap) improves mean net P&L per trade in the forward cohort.
kill_criteria: Forward stopped trades become profitable or break-even with current placement (stop was right), or window-exit P&L turns more negative than stopped-trade P&L (stop was protecting).

evidence.author: detective:betfair
evidence.note: premise holds: 60/75 price down after LAY entry (80%), yet P&L negative in every exit class except 3 target hits

evidence.author: detective:betfair
evidence.note: STOP_PUMP_RESUMED: 20 trades, 0 wins, -5.51 of -8.84 total; stop distance 0.25-0.5 vs pump_size 0.65-1.8

evidence.author: detective:betfair
evidence.note: ruled out: hedge cost ~0, sim-vs-live identical (-0.119 vs -0.113/trade); 3 unhedged live positions (liquidity gate failure at exit)

evidence.author: detective:betfair
evidence.note: payoff asymmetry 0.62 (avg win +0.092 vs avg loss -0.150) inverts the 80% directional edge

evidence.author: statistician
evidence.note: Experiment matrix: widening stop_ticks 2->3->5->100(no stop) leaves P&L at -1.16..-1.26 on replay; stop exits vanish but losses persist. Stop-inside-pump is real (D-0007 stands as diagnosis) but fixing it does NOT fix expectancy — the pump-fade shape itself has negative payoff asymmetry.

evidence.author: statistician
evidence.note: Structural flip (BACK continuation) also falsified: 9/9 variants negative, no significant direction dominance (4/6 pairs, p=0.34), best cell failed OOS (-0.32). The stop-inside-pump diagnosis stands, but neither direction of the pump-completion trade has positive expectancy. Pump-fade family closed at this stake/structure level.
